scalable_minimum_review.candidate_rows: All otherwise-eligible price+historicalindustry+latest full annual identity/field/age rows, without future returns or selection ranks.
scalable_minimum_review.required_set: For every otherwise-eligible row collect ALL unresolved earlier notice blockers; union after removing known disjoint scopes. Do not restrict to only single-blocker rows. Deduplicate by issuer+document hash across months.
scalable_minimum_review.ordering: Prioritize reduction in otherwise-eligible blocked rows per readable source length; no observed return, expected factor score, final rank or target performance in queue.
scalable_minimum_review.machine_proposals: Full readable body or visually resolved blank pages, issuer match, exact affirmative scope/closure/replacement quotations, period-type parsing, field-equivalence checks, quote-span and hash validation. Complete enumerated finite corrections plus named completed replacements can support bounded scope; missing warning keywords cannot.
scalable_minimum_review.negative_search: Future unusable/ongoing investigation/unquantified adjustment words only flag or prioritize; absence never proves clearance.
scalable_minimum_review.root_audit: Approve evidence-backed rule families with independent review of every high-risk/edge-case family and frozen hash-selected stratified audit of other matched documents. Sampling gives observed rule error, not individual certainty; mark rule-qualified vs document-reviewed separately. False clearances quarantine the family and restore affected rows to unknown until repaired/rechecked.
scalable_minimum_review.limits: Six reviewed notices are examples, not independent classifier validation. No scope or effect experiment expansion.
